alu.contract: 32-bit RTLLM-derived ALU. Keep all ports and opcode parameters/defaults. Preserve the 33-bit expression context and define zero from the entire 33-bit res. Immediate shifts use all of a (amounts >= 32 need the original oversized behavior); variable shifts use a[4:0]. SLLV is left, SRLV logical right, and SRAV arithmetic right. LUI uses a[15:0]. carry, negative and overflow are constant 0. flag is the comparator for SLT/SLTU and 0 for all other opcodes. Unsupported opcodes, including JR, give r=0 and zero=1.

multiplier.contract: Combinational full-width 16-bit unsigned product of 8-bit inputs A and B.

shifter.contract: 8-bit zero-fill logical right shift, out = in >> ctrl for all ctrl=0..7. The bits form a combined shift amount, not a one-hot selector. Example: 8'h80 >> 3 = 8'h10.

counter.contract: 4-bit modulo-12 counter, asynchronous active-low reset to zero, rising-edge clock, valid_count enables increments. Wrap 11 to 0; hold when disabled.

arbiter.contract: 8-bit combinational, lowest index wins. req=0x00 -> grant=0x00; req=0x01 -> 0x01; req=0x06 -> 0x02; req=0x81 or 0xff -> 0x01. One-hot grant. Bit i wins iff req[i] is 1 and no lower numbered bit is 1.

fifo.contract: Four 8-bit entries; synchronous active-high reset at posedge. Compute take_write from wr_en and !full, and take_read from rd_en and !empty using pre-edge flags. If both are accepted, both pointers advance and occupancy holds. If full, a simultaneous request reads only; if empty, it writes only. dout holds outside valid reads and resets to 0.
